what_happened.line: The committee heard that no new architect number would be ready for the Finance Committee, so its designated member will not attend and the matter waits for Town Meeting.
Members walked through the draft Town Meeting presentation and agreed edits, ending the floor plan section with the colored wing version and revising the parking language.
The committee agreed to add a slide on major renovation cost categories and the level three trigger, with the wording to be run through the architect.
A resident's cost-per-square-foot calculation was confirmed as accurate, and a member proposed getting a realistic new-build cost before asking Town Meeting to approve renovation.
The committee voted only on prior minutes and adjournment; a resident said in public comment that she does not agree with the project's scope.

why_it_matters: Voters at Town Meeting will be asked to approve a renovation without an updated architect cost number, and the committee has not yet put a new-build cost beside it for comparison.
Whether the renovation figure reflects required system upgrades or optional uses, such as the self-funded extended day program, bears on how much of the cost residents are asked to carry.
